dct_description_sm:
Polygon data representing Maximum Observed Flooding extents within the County of Essex. Maximum observed flooding extents are based on field surveys during specific events and are not considered comprehensive. In some cases these observed extents may exceed extents of modelled flood prone areas.

Contains flood extent data provided by the Essex Region Conservation Authority (ERCA) and the Lower Thames Conservation Authority (LTVCA) for the purpose of inclusion into the County of Essex Official Plan (2014). Please contact the Conservation Authority for the most up to date information.
